meta.title: Products — ALA CORE
meta.description: Apps and products we build and run to help restaurants, clinics, schools, shops, offices, and factories work better.

en.heading: Products we build and run
en.support: Tools we own, operate, and keep improving. Each one is built around a real business job.

products.name: ALA Menu
products.tagline: Digital menu and QR ordering for restaurants and cafés.
products.description: Guests scan a QR code, see your menu, and place orders. You update prices and dishes anytime.

products.name: ALA Book
products.description: Let customers book a table, slot, or visit from your website or WhatsApp. Reduce no-shows with reminders.
products.forWhom: for clinics, salons, schools, and restaurants

products.name: ALA Store
products.tagline: Your own online store and ordering page.
products.description: Sell products, take orders, and accept payments without relying on third-party marketplaces.

products.name: ALA Chat
products.description: Answer opening hours, bookings, and order questions automatically. Hand over to a human when needed.

products.name: ALA Flow
products.description: Send reminders, update records, and move information between systems without manual copying.

products.name: ALA Insight
products.description: See today's sales, stock, visits, or staff hours in one clear view. No spreadsheet wrangling.
